sources.entry: ZeroBraneStudio - ZeroBrane Studio is a lightweight cross-platform Lua IDE with code completion, syntax highlighting, remote debugger, code analyzer, live coding, and debugging support for various Lua engines.

summary.one_liner: ZeroBrane Studio is a lightweight, cross-platform IDE for Lua with code completion, a remote and local debugger, static analysis, and live coding support for many Lua engines.
summary.what_it_does: The IDE provides syntax highlighting and folding for 125+ languages and file formats, with auto-complete for functions, keywords and custom APIs, including scope-aware variable completion. It includes an integrated debugger for local and remote debugging of Lua 5.1 through 5.4, LuaJIT and other engines, plus an interactive console for running snippets locally or remotely. Navigation features include Go To File, project-wide Go To Symbol, Go to definition, and a function outline. Editing tools include multi-cursor editing, scope-aware renaming, and find and replace across multiple files with preview and undo. It bundles luasocket, luafilesystem, lpeg and luasec, and can be extended through packages, translations and user configuration.
use_cases: live coding with LÖVE or Gideros
static analysis to catch Lua typos
developing games or apps in Moai, Corona or Cocos2d-x
editing OpenResty/Nginx or Redis Lua scripts
how_to_run: Download an installation package for your platform from the releases, or clone/download a snapshot of the repository
Repository copy on Linux or macOS: run ./zbstudio.sh
Windows: run zbstudio from the install directory or use zbstudio.exe
notable: Remote debugger and live coding for many Lua engines including LÖVE, Gideros, Moai and Corona
Scope-aware variable completion, selection and renaming
Static analysis for errors and typos
Extensible through packages, translations and cfg settings
Runs from any directory with no compilation needed
caveats: Only one instance launches by default; extra launches pass files and directories to the running instance
Command-line configuration changes apply only to the current session
